title: KapeCon 2026: The Ultimate Guide to Coffee, Tastings, Talks, and More
summary: KapeCon 2026 returns to Paseo de Roxas, Makati, on October 10–11, with free admission, coffee tastings, brewing workshops, live competitions, and opportunities to discover Philippine coffee producers.
